enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +11: Passive: +11 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Insightful Necromancy Focus +2: +2 Insight bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Blighted Lore +13: Passive: Your Acid, Negative, Poison and Evil spells gain a 13% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Blight +86: Passive: +86 Equipment bonus to Acid, Negative, Poison and Evil Spell Power.
Lesser Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by one.
Equipoised Focus: Your two-handed weapon gains a +2 Exceptional focus to Spell DCs and is considered an Implement.
